name: upgrade-test
description: Install the version users already have, put data in it, upgrade in place, and check the data survived.

from_build.description: The build users are coming FROM. Resolved against the artifact store the same way `latest` is. Required: an upgrade test with no starting version is an install test.

from_sha256.description: Pins the starting build by hash instead of by name, for reproducing a specific report.

seed_flow.description: A Maestro flow run against the OLD build to create state worth preserving — sign in, add a record, set a preference. Without it this proves only that the app still launches.

verify_flow.description: A Maestro flow run against the NEW build that asserts the state is still there. Its failure is the finding.

app_id.description: Bundle id / package name, for the launch check. Defaults to the suite's app_id.

keep_data.description: Whether the upgrade preserves data. True installs over the top, which is what users experience. False uninstalls first, which measures nothing and exists only to produce a contrasting run when a migration is suspected.
